note: Gaming and robustness suite. Each case pairs an honest answer with an attempt to score well without being right (or with noise a real miner would emit). rule: below_honest = the attack must score clearly under the honest answer; near_zero = it must be near zero; near_honest = the noise must NOT collapse a correct answer.

cases.name: question-echo
cases.question: What is the capital of Australia?
cases.ground_truth: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
cases.attack: What is the capital of Australia? The capital of Australia is what is asked about Australia's capital.
cases.why: Repeating the prompt shares wording with the ground truth without answering it.

cases.name: shotgun-candidates
cases.question: What is the capital of Australia?
cases.ground_truth: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
cases.attack: Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Darwin, Hobart, Auckland, Wellington.
cases.why: Listing every candidate guarantees a hit on any ground truth; precision has to punish it.

cases.name: negation-insert
cases.question: Is the certificate for expired.example.com currently valid?
cases.honest: It is expired, so not valid.
cases.attack: The certificate has expired is something we would say, but the certificate has not expired.
cases.why: Reuses the ground truth's words while inverting the claim.

cases.name: verdict-flip
cases.question: Was the supplied passage written by an AI?
cases.attack: No, the passage is not AI-generated, it was written by a human.
cases.why: Maximum lexical overlap, opposite verdict. The single most important case for a detection intent.

cases.name: direction-flip
cases.question: If a central bank cuts its policy rate, what usually happens to bond prices?
cases.why: One word apart from the ground truth and wrong; a bag of words scores it near perfect.

cases.name: number-swap
cases.question: What is tomorrow's maximum temperature in Berlin?
cases.why: Right shape, wrong figure. Numbers are where a weather or finance answer goes wrong.

cases.name: word-order-swap
cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.ground_truth: Paris is the capital of France.
cases.honest: The capital of France is Paris.
cases.attack: France is the capital of Paris.
cases.why: Identical vocabulary to the honest answer, reversed claim.

cases.name: stopword-spam
cases.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
cases.ground_truth: The Pacific Ocean is the largest.
cases.attack: the and of to is a in on at for with by as it that this these those there their be been being have has had will would could should

cases.name: filler-padding
cases.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
cases.ground_truth: The Pacific Ocean is the largest.
cases.honest: The Pacific Ocean is the largest of them.
cases.attack: Sure, happy to help with this question. Based on the information provided, and according to the following, please note that overall, in conclusion, the Pacific Ocean is the largest. Let me know if you would like additional information about this answer.
cases.why: Real miners pad with boilerplate. A correct answer wrapped in filler must stay a correct answer.

cases.name: unicode-noise
cases.question: In which year did humans first land on the Moon?
cases.attack: Apollo 11 landed in 1969 🚀🌙 — 登月 مرحبا без проблем
cases.why: Emoji, CJK, Arabic and Cyrillic must not crash the module or wipe out a correct answer.

cases.name: gt-plus-dump
cases.question: Which paper introduced the transformer architecture?
cases.ground_truth: Attention Is All You Need, Vaswani et al., 2017.
cases.honest: Vaswani and colleagues, Attention Is All You Need (2017).
cases.attack: Attention Is All You Need. Also ImageNet Classification, BERT, GPT-2, ResNet, AlexNet, Word2Vec, Seq2Seq, ELMo, T5, RoBERTa, XLNet, ALBERT, DistilBERT, Longformer, Reformer, Performer, Linformer, Megatron, Switch Transformer, PaLM, Chinchilla, LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon.
cases.why: The right answer buried in a keyword dump should not beat the right answer given plainly.

cases.name: empty-ish
cases.question: What is the capital of Australia?
cases.ground_truth: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
